1. Review the changes made in the current conversation..

2. Commit changes using git following one of these templates:

In Case of a Single Task:
TASK-ID: Short description of changes made
(Example: T001: Implemented feature X, fixed bug Y, and updated documentation)

In Case of Multiple Tasks:
TASK-ID-First-TASK-ID-Last: Short description of changes made
(Example: T001-T005: Implemented feature X, fixed bug Y, and updated documentation)

Note: do not forget to stage your changes before committing.

3. If no changes were made, respond with "No changes to commit."
